primary.notes: Printed: 'The performance level of HiTEC® 12204L can also be achieved through the use of HiTEC® 12250 booster package at 4.2% in combination with HiTEC® 12200 at 10.3%' (Afton HiTEC 12204L PDS, 06/17, p.2). The booster's chemistry is not stated.

treat_rate.printed_text: HiTEC® 12250 booster package at 4.2% in combination with HiTEC® 12200 at 10.3%
treat_rate.calculation_note: Formulation-specific dose only: 4.2% HiTEC® 12250 together with 10.3% HiTEC® 12200, stated to achieve the performance level of HiTEC® 12204L (recommended at '14.2% wt', API CI-4 Plus SAE 15W-40). Not a general treat rate; no min/max/typical range is printed. Printed '%' (basis not stated for this dose). The archived HiTEC 12200 leaflet DL2-14639.pdf p.2 prints the same combination ('14.2% HiTEC® 12204L = 10.3% HiTEC® 12200 + 4.2% HiTEC® 12250').

open_questions: Source: no HiTEC 12250 data sheet is in the archive or was found. All values come from Afton's HiTEC 12204L PDS (printed edition '06/17', © 2017 Afton Chemical Corporation), retrieved as the Internet Archive original-bytes copy captured 2020-10-23 (SHA-256 7a1e57d81d66b52b83215da261732256867d89b651c75334068022362a74183e), p.2 'Typical Characteristics' column 'HiTEC® 12250'. Afton's live site blocks automated access. The archived HiTEC 12200 leaflet DL2-14639.pdf gives only the dose.

Printed properties with no field in the component template (HiTEC 12204L PDS 06/17, p.2, column 'HiTEC® 12250', typical characteristics): Density, lbs/gal. 7.67; Specific Gravity @ 15.6/15.6°C 0.920; Viscosity @ 100°C, cSt 175; Flash Point, °C (PMCC) 135 min.
Handling information printed for 'HiTEC® 12204L and HiTEC® 12250' (p.2), no template field: Max Handling Temp: 70˚C; Shelf Life: 3 months @ 45°C, 36 months @ ambient (10-40°C).

Treat rate: the only dose is 4.2% with 10.3% HiTEC® 12200 to reach HiTEC® 12204L performance (12204L itself: 14.2% wt). The basis of the 4.2% is not printed, and 10.3% + 4.2% = 14.5% differs from the 14.2% 12204L rate; recorded as printed, not reconciled. Confirm with Afton.

Chemical family, active content, carrier identity/share, compatibility restrictions and Ca, Mg, P, Zn, Mo contents are not printed; left Missing and not inferred from HiTEC 12204L or HiTEC 12200. component_subtype left null (booster, not VM or PPD). Confirm with Afton.
